problem.title: Provide care. Agree the costs clearly.
problem.text: On-call services and additional care can create separate costs. A longer home visit is not automatically a private service. Whether billing is permitted and whether reimbursement is available are two separate reviews.

solution.title: Plan early and review benefits separately
solution.text: Up to EUR 3,000 in health budget over two years comes from a suitable outpatient plan under its terms. A health fund bonus may offset all or part of the premium. Midwifery costs and hospital benefits require their own review; they are not automatically added to the budget.

klinik.title: For newborn cover, timing matters
klinik.subtitle: Newborn enrolment depends on legal and policy requirements. Midwives give a pointer; Healio reviews the individual case.
klinik.detailsLabel: View details on newborn enrolment and hospital cover
klinik.kernTitle: Registration within two months may allow cover from birth.
klinik.kernText: Under section 198 of the German Insurance Contract Act, newborn enrolment can provide cover without risk surcharges or waiting periods, backdated to birth. The requested cover must not be higher or broader than the insured parent’s cover. Die Bayerische requires three months of parental prior insurance; SDK does not. The parent’s policy must be in place in time.
klinik.chanceTitle: Why an early review is useful
klinik.chanceText: Health declarations can affect a later application. An early review clarifies the options for parents and child. It is neither a medical assessment nor a promise that every desired plan is available.
klinik.chanceObenText: SDK SP1 and SP2 include rooming-in for insured children under 16, single or twin rooms depending on the plan, private medical treatment and hospital choice. Healio explains the terms with the family.
klinik.deadlineText: Point families to the two-month newborn registration deadline and refer them to Healio for an individual review. You do not need to compare insurers or assess health declarations. Prior insurance periods and the level of cover are checked against the actual policy.
klinik.ehrlichTitle: Distinguish an ongoing pregnancy from future cover
klinik.ehrlichText: With die Bayerische, a pregnancy already medically confirmed when applying is not covered. Eight months of waiting apply to childbirth and, according to the confirmed current claims practice, also to the named outpatient services during pregnancy and postnatal care. Individual SDK outpatient screening benefits are reviewed separately; they do not imply cover for childbirth.
klinik.roomingText: Interested families contact Healio directly. We review existing cover, desired benefits, deadlines and exclusions before recommending a plan or submitting an application. No retrospective cover is promised.
klinik.compareSubtitle: Premiums, health questions, waiting periods and benefits differ. Healio compares suitable options; the midwife remains an information provider.

tarife.title: What Healio clarifies with your families
tarife.lead: Outpatient cover is about antenatal care during pregnancy; inpatient cover is about the hospital and the child.

ambulant.label: Outpatient
ambulant.title: Antenatal care during pregnancy
ambulant.text: A suitable outpatient plan may include additional screening such as detailed ultrasound, toxoplasmosis tests or a nuchal translucency scan. Individual benefits may be relevant during an existing pregnancy; Healio reviews them separately.
ambulant.condition: Health declarations, acceptance and policy terms determine cover. A screening budget does not promise cover for childbirth or complications.

stationaer.label: Inpatient
stationaer.title: Hospital care and cover for the child
stationaer.text: A suitable hospital plan may provide private medical treatment and a single or twin room. Newborn enrolment requires suitable parental cover, timely registration and the other applicable conditions. The child’s cover must not be higher or broader than the insured parent’s cover.
stationaer.condition: Register within two months of birth. Die Bayerische requires at least three months of parental prior insurance; SDK requires no prior insurance period. Enrolment without health questions and backdated cover from birth depend on the applicable requirements. For an existing pregnancy, review the start of cover, waiting periods and exclusions for ongoing or recommended examinations and treatment separately.

tarife.both: A family can have both an outpatient and an inpatient plan. An outpatient-only policy for the parents gives the child no inpatient cover. In a consultation, Healio clarifies which plans fit.

bayerische.label: Good to know
bayerische.title: Die Bayerische and your midwifery services
bayerische.text: Komfort and Prestige provide hospital benefits under the respective plan. Outpatient midwifery services are reviewed under confirmed current claims practice; the terms contain no separate explicit promise for them. A family room at childbirth follows the mother’s policy: Prestige without a plan-specific monetary cap, Komfort up to the twin-room benefit.
bayerische.condition: Eight months of waiting apply to childbirth and, under confirmed claims practice, also to the named outpatient pregnancy and postnatal services. Ongoing or recommended examinations and treatment are excluded. Request a written review of the specific case beforehand.

legal.title: Three roles. Clear responsibilities.
legal.subtitle: Billing and insurance benefits are separate decisions.
legal.text: The midwife clarifies the permitted service and fee. Healio reviews cover. The insurer confirms which reimbursement is possible in the individual case.
legal.summary: The midwife does not promise insurance cover or reimbursement. Individual billing and agreements must follow the applicable statutory and fee rules.

steps.title: This is how easy it works for you.
steps.step1Desc: Allow 45 minutes. We explain the concept and you decide whether it fits your work.
steps.step2Desc: Use the templates and checklists for your practice and families. Complete them individually and check the requirements.
steps.step3Desc: Interested families contact Healio directly. We review needs, health declarations, deadlines and terms; the insurer decides on acceptance and benefits.
steps.easeNote: You provide professional care. Financial options and insurance cover are clarified separately.

moral.title: Good information gives families more room to choose.
moral.text1: Pregnancy and the start of family life often bring additional health costs. A neutral introduction to possible health-insurance bonuses and suitable supplementary cover helps families review their options at their own pace.
moral.text2: Your role stays clear: you support and inform. Healio explains the financial options to interested families and takes care of the next steps.
moral.text3: This lets you offer a helpful information pathway without having to advise or sell. You decide how it fits your work and the families you support.

examples.title: Two examples from midwifery practice
examples.lead: Make remaining costs visible. Clarify billing and insurance cover first.

onCall.title: On-call service: what remains?
onCall.text: Assume a fee of EUR 800 and an approved health fund subsidy of EUR 250. The family’s remaining cost is EUR 550.
onCall.note: This is not a reimbursement promise. The actual subsidy, agreement and any insurance benefit must be reviewed individually.

homeVisit.title: A 60- or 75-minute home visit
homeVisit.text: More time does not automatically mean more privately billable fees. The service actually provided is what matters.
steps: Check the statutory billing position, time and contact limits, and any medical order.
Agree only separately permitted private services specifically and in writing beforehand; no double billing.
Then request a written review of possible insurance benefits.
homeVisit.note: No flat extra-time charge or fixed amount per visit. The service, fee rules and invoice must match.

downloads.waitTitle: Review before a pregnancy: eight months of waiting
downloads.waitText: With die Bayerische, eight months of waiting run from the start of insurance for childbirth and, under confirmed current claims practice, also for the named outpatient pregnancy and postnatal services. The product summary excludes ongoing or recommended examinations and treatment. Completing the waiting period does not guarantee reimbursement: outpatient claims practice is not a separate explicit plan promise. Request a written review of the specific case beforehand.

roles.title: Midwife: service and billing
roles.text: You clarify the permitted private service, fee basis and prior written agreement. Statutory services are not billed twice.

roles.title: Healio: review cover
roles.text: We review the policy, health declarations, deadlines and potential benefit for the specific case.

roles.title: Insurer: confirm reimbursement
roles.text: The insurer makes the binding acceptance and benefit decisions. The family supplies the required evidence.

items.question: Does die Bayerische automatically reimburse outpatient midwifery costs?
items.answer: No. The named outpatient services are subject to confirmed current claims practice, not a separate explicit plan promise. Healio requests a written review of requirements, evidence and the specific case beforehand.

items.question: Do the eight months also apply to outpatient services?
items.answer: Die Bayerische has confirmed eight months from the start of insurance for the named outpatient pregnancy and postnatal services. Childbirth has eight months of waiting too. Completing that period alone does not guarantee reimbursement. Review the options before a pregnancy and clarify the specific case in writing.

items.question: What if the pregnancy has already been confirmed?
items.answer: Die Bayerische’s product summary excludes ongoing or recommended examinations and treatment. Whether later outpatient midwifery services can be considered after the waiting period requires a written review of the specific case. Review individual SDK outpatient screening benefits separately; these do not promise immediate cover for childbirth or ongoing treatment.

items.question: Can a longer visit simply be charged as a private extra?
items.answer: No. Check statutory benefits, time and contact limits, and any medical order first. Separately permitted private services must be agreed specifically and in writing before the service is provided. This does not justify a flat EUR 50 charge or double billing.

items.question: Which policy provides the family room?
items.answer: With die Bayerische, it follows the mother’s policy: Prestige without a plan-specific monetary cap, Komfort up to the twin-room benefit. Policy requirements, eight months of waiting and timely cover remain essential.

items.question: Can I use the templates unchanged as a validated contract?
items.answer: No. The downloads are working aids. Review and complete the service, fee basis, statutory billing rules and individual agreement before use. They do not replace a reimbursement confirmation.
